name: KBiDir V4 cyclic collection
step: Check V4-r3 cyclic collection, loss recovery, snapshot replacement and bounded deadline
rationale: Uses kbidir-msp217-v4-r3 96-byte no-version vectors (signature/type/status, 14 pairs per block) with strict zero padding. Empty direct requests, one pending request, missing middle block recovered in a later cycle, repeated metadata preserves partial pairs, snapshot IDs never mix, duplicate validation and 30-second page-local deadline. Local editor remains separate from immutable received data; Save/presets/MSP218 remain disabled. Capture age is separate from retrieval duration. Synthetic link timings are not RF qualification. K-PROG/PDF cases verify independent alarm Ah scaling, three corrected chemistry pointers with in-place bounds, preserved received outliers versus invalid new edits, governor/brake transitions, joint RC endpoint validity in both pulse directions, exact known alarm layouts and conservative unknown current locks. Harness loads actual English expert labels and verifies exactly nine field markers plus the permanent Expert Settings * switch, with all standard labels unmarked in both modes. APK expert-group fields default locked; opt-out restores all captured expert/cutoff values while preserving standard/alarm drafts. Tests cover explicit opt-in, stale callbacks, lifecycle resets and capability/dependency locks. Chemistry defaults800/3000/2300mV remain distinct from received/draft values and survive chemistry/Expert transitions. Default parameter set starts unselected; explicit targets2/3/4/5/6 apply only additive local masks, with F5A fallback and notice. Selection/clearing preserve captured data and drafts, expert toggles retain masks, and stale callbacks cannot bypass locks. Load Preset is visible but disabled; no preview or edit queues writes. Simulator ESC gearing is raw100 (1:1) while the shared hardware fixture stays raw950. The first gear edit waits for confirmation; subsequent plus/minus edits after Confirm do not prompt again during the page visit. Cancel preserves the draft without acknowledgment. Bounds remain enforced, preview/Expert retain acknowledgment, and Reload/lifecycle reset it and invalidate stale confirmation without writes. Forward/backward grants local editing only with explicit Car6 preview. Both received bit values are tested across all other targets, Expert off/on, leaving/returning to Car, Reload and reopen; locked setters reject edits and Car preserves the raw capture. Missing/ambiguous data stays unavailable, rotation remains independent and no write request is emitted. Regression cases cover explicit expected block offsets and chemistry transitions between signed numeric controls, oversized U32 static values and back, including expert opt-out.
